subject: Quick plan before class
text:
Sorry this is rushed. I just remembered the group cleanup is tomorrow, and if we keep going the way we are we’ll end up standing around with no bags and half the group waiting for someone who never shows up. I think we need a simple plan tonight, even if it’s ugly.

The tiny issue is the shared signup sheet. When I opened it on my phone it asked for permission again, which means at least three people might not know they’re on the roster. Could you try opening it from the library wifi before dinner? If it still glitches, we can screenshot the names into the group chat and treat that as backup. I don’t want the coordinator to get stuck because we didn’t double-check something so basic.

For the activity, maybe meet at the south entrance instead of the playground, because there’s more room to split into pairs. I’ll bring the spare gloves from the cabinet, and you can grab the folding box from the club closet if you have the code. If the app on your laptop won’t load the map, send me a photo of the route instead of spending ten minutes restarting everything.

Just tell me yes or no by nine, because I’m probably still printing flyers. If the sheet remains locked, I’ll email the professor and ask for a clean copy. Better to fix it now than discover at eight a.m. that nobody actually signed up.
